thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: degraded ILB cross-region routing detected for Redwood Private (vpc-projects) — multiple healthcheck flaps & control-plane 5xx for us-west1 <-> eu-west1 at 1999994321. Auto-escalating to on-call.

sarah-ops: Acknowledged. Paging net oncall, will pull customers list.

mike-net: Looking. GCP ILB control plane is returning 502/503 for a subset of API calls (forwarding-rules / target-pools) and our auth-proxy is seeing 401 token refresh failures to IdP (Okta) around the same time. Also seeing Datadog / metrics-ingest 429s which coincide with healthcheck gaps. Hypothesis: combined auth refresh failures + metric ingestion backpressure caused healthcheck noise -> endpoints marked unhealthy -> cross-region routing fanout.

joe-sre: Can you paste the control-plane errors? I can run quick queries.

mike-net: Pasted snippets from proxy logs: `ERROR auth: token refresh failed status=401 detail="invalid_grant"` and GCP API responses: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` for `compute.forwardingRules.get` inside 30s window.

joe-sre: Running quick check for affected project `proj-priv-vpc-42`:

```bash
# check forwarding rules and backend health
gcloud compute forwarding-rules list --regions=us-west1,eu-west1 --project=proj-priv-vpc-42
gcloud compute backend-services get-health my-ilb-backend --project=proj-priv-vpc-42 --region=us-west1
```

joe-sre: Output: several backends intermittently UNHEALTHY even though instance groups report healthy locally. Healthcheck probes are timing out for the control-plane (50-300ms inconsistent).

alice-pm: Customer impact? Which customers are seeing errors? Need ticket numbers for comms.

natalie-support: Two customers reported 502/connection errors for services routed via private VPCs earlier: TCK-4821 and STR-9130. Both in EU region but cross-region sessions from US also affected. I'm drafting a status note.

dmitri-ml: Model-serving sessions dropped for a few high-throughput endpoints, saw >10% request error rate spike for a 12-minute window. Losing stateful KV cache on reconnect made latency worse.

mike-net: Short mitigation plan we can try now: (1) force regional routing for critical projects so control-plane calls stay regional, (2) temporarily bypass Datadog correlation for health decisions (stop using external metric enrichment for healthchecks), (3) open GCP case and request control-plane retry/backoff investigation, (4) rotate auth-proxy token client credentials as a stopgap if IdP errors persist.

joe-sre: Implemented mitigation (1) for proj-priv-vpc-42: updated forwarding-rule target to regional target proxy to avoid cross-region control-plane path. Command used:

```bash
# example (ran with --quiet)
gcloud compute forwarding-rules set-target my-ilb-rule --region=us-west1 --target-https-proxy=my-regional-proxy --project=proj-priv-vpc-42
```

joe-sre: Also temporarily toggled healthcheck policy to prefer direct TCP probe over enriched metric check for that backend. Observing stabilization in last 120s.

incident-bot: Update: mitigation applied to 1 project. Monitoring for 10m window.

mike-net: Opened GCP support case 2026-PRIV-1643 referencing control-plane 503s and forwardingRules. Case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/2026-PRIV-1643 (internal). Escalated to Tier 2.

sarah-ops: Good. Natalie please notify the two customers with current status and that we're actively mitigating (done). Include recommendation: expect intermittent 502s for up to 1 hour while GCP completes control-plane stabilization.

natalie-support: Message sent to TCK-4821 & STR-9130. Included temporary workaround: prefer regional endpoint (we gave them a short config snippet).

mike-net: On the auth side, I'm seeing IdP (Okta) token introspection rate-limits for our client id — hitting ~5xx/429 on refresh bursts. Reached out to IdP on support channel to confirm they saw a spike. If tokens are failing at scale, need to fallback to cached tokens for short window or rotate to alternative credentials.

joe-sre: Quick rollback option: disable proxy token refresh and allow existing tokens to continue for 5m windows (risk: expired tokens). Prefer a short-lived bypass rather than full credential rotation during mitigation.

mike-net: Applied token refresh backoff and increased cache TTL for refresh results (5m). Watching auth-proxy logs now. Token 401s have dropped.

dmitri-ml: Error rate trending down from 12% -> 1.2% after regional routing + token backoff. Cache warms back up. :+1:

incident-bot: Update posted to incident timeline. Notifying on-call for EU shift at 1999994500.

sarah-ops: Preparing handoff. Next on-call (oncall-eu) take over monitoring. Key items for handoff: GCP case 2026-PRIV-1643, projects affected list (proj-priv-vpc-42, proj-priv-vpc-77), commands run (forwarding-rules set-target, healthcheck toggle), IdP support ticket open, customers TCK-4821 & STR-9130 notified.

mike-net: Added runbook snippets to incident ticket: `runbooks/privvpc-ilb-crossregion.md` (internal). Also flagged to revert temporary healthcheck bypass after GCP confirms control plane stable.

oncall-eu: Acknowledged takeover. Will monitor until control-plane case resolved and confirm customers see no more 502s. Please leave contact for direct if case escalates.

alice-pm: Assigning postmortem owner: mike-net. Deliverable: timeline, root cause (GCP control-plane + IdP rate-limits + Datadog ingestion pressure), mitigation steps, and customer comms draft. ETA: EOD.

sarah-ops: Thanks team. After handoff I'll update the status page and close the paging if no further regressions.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> partial (mitigations in place, observation ongoing). Next update required by 1999994621 or on significant change.

joe-sre: One note for follow-up: add sentinel tests to detect token-introspect rate limits and metric-enrichment backpressure to avoid healthcheck dependence causing routing cascades.

natalie-support: I'll follow up with both customers once we see 30m of stable traffic.

oncall-eu: Taking it. Posting a short checklist in the handoff channel.

sarah-ops: Handoff complete. Closing this thread for active paging. Will re-open if GCP case returns bad news. :white_check_mark:
